negative_reviews.author: Yuki
negative_reviews.text:
I got good gyoza, but rainbow roll... Well it was kinda shit and I just ate it cuz I spent money on it. Rice kinda too sticky(had to scrape rolls of the plate), fish had no taste at all, and prices are expensive just for this. Not a fan of rolls, but theesse weren't great. Maybe I should have bought a bowl, but I wasn't really hungry.

Summary:
Yeah, disappointed with my rolls.
Gyoza was good thought
